selection: Four new configurations plus exact reused49.28 control. Rank inner correct count, macro-F1, declared order. Final choice uses only cached inner predictions.
features: Original MiniLM384+AV128 and age-free language16, plus1536 frozen WavLM final-hidden mean/std from at most64 nonoverlapping4s clips spread over each supplied whole-interview WAV. No questionnaire targets/answers or speaker guessing.
preprocessing: Fitting-only original base scaler/PCA32, language scaler with fixedscale.5, speech scaler/whitenedPCA16. Speech scale.5 or2. Same normalizedsqrt class weights; no resampling/calibration.
capacity: 64 classifier coordinates,325 coefficients/intercepts; no fine-tuning of pretrained speech encoder. C=.001 or.01.
motivation: Previous searches mostly reused MFCC/visual/text features; the ledger contains no frozen self-supervised speech encoder. Speech representations might add acoustic information for Mild/Moderate cases missed by text. This is a hypothesis, not a guaranteed60% solution.
evaluation: Original163 people, same5 outer/3 inner folds and seeds42/137/2026. No validation/test scoring, no external participants. All segment ownership remains within participant.
stopping_rule: One feature approach, four fixed configurations; at most225 nested pipeline fits and2 full-training fits. No outer-informed search expansion.
promotion_rule: Only a higher primary score on identical folds can earn best-observed status. Distinguish paired conditional evidence from independent confirmation. Retain original49.28 artifacts always.
